newsitem.title: USA: Folgers raises price for 13 ounce can of coffee.
newsitem.headline: Folgers raises price for 13 ounce can of coffee.

text.p: Folgers Coffee Co. said Tuesday it raised by 20 cents the list price on its standard 13-ounce cans of ground regular and decaffeinated coffees.
The company, a unit of Procter & Gamble, cited higher prices of green coffee on the world's futures markets.
The increase, which is to take effect immediately, brings the new price for a standard can of regular coffee to $3.06, and decaffeinated ground Folgers up to $3.76, Folgers said.

"The list price of Folgers coffee generally reflects the price of green coffee sold on the commodity market," the Folgers' statement said. "Green coffee prices have been rising since January, and have continued due to a number of factors including reduced crop estimates for the upcoming harvest in Brazil, reduced availability of coffee from Central America and Colombia, and the generally tight supply of arabica beans on the worldwide coffee market."
Folgers last announced a price increase on March 10, when it raised the list price on its standard 13-ounce can by 15 cents just one week after a 45-cent price hike went into effect.
The company said Folgers Instant coffee and Folgers Singles will remain unchanged at this time because those coffees have different blends and processing methods than the ground coffees.
